content:
julia: starting a thread for the Nimbus board EAP runbook. goal: quick, reproducible benchmarks + safe telemetry sharing. need an owner for the runbook and a short lab schedule.
kevin: I can own the runbook. will draft a lean template focused on reproducibility (containers + seed) and measurement bins.
omar: thanks. include these measurement buckets: seq<=128, 128<seq<=512, seq>512. collect throughput_tok_s, lat_p99_ms, mem_peak_mb, power_watts, gpu_temp_c.
julia: good set. can you add a cold-start test (fresh KV cache) and a warmed-up run? label them explicitly in the CSV.
kevin: yep. also planning two modes: interactive/low-latency (batch=1, async) and bulk throughput (batch>1, sync). will add both.
tess: legal asked us to avoid any marketing/press text in the runbook repo. also: partner asked about telemetry schema in the NDA. legalbot, can you confirm minimal telemetry language we can include?
legalbot: Legal: use privacy-safe telemetry appendix. minimal schema allowed: run_id, model_variant, seq_len, throughput_tok_s, lat_p99_ms, mem_peak_mb, env (region/tag). No PII, no raw payloads. Partner must sign telemetry appendix prior to data exchange.
omar: noted. partner also asked for kernel-level logs for perf debugging. we should not require kernel symbols. propose aggregated histograms + hashed stack traces only.
julia: agreed: aggregated histograms and opaque stack hashes are fine. include a short example payload in the appendix.
kevin: adding a sample CLI for partners to reproduce:
```
./run_nimbus_bench.sh --image redwood/nimbus:eap --model edge-v2 --mode interactive --seq 256 --out result.json
```
Inside result.json we expect a summary object with the buckets mentioned above.
tess: marketplace note: partner is interested in a joint listing after the EAP. we should add an "embargo" checkbox and a PR contact list (marketing+partner comms). don't publish anything until mutual sign-off.
julia: timeline proposal: runbook v0 by Fri (internal review), send NDA appendix + runbook to partner Mon, partner runs tests Tue-Wed next week, joint sync Thu. buffer week after for follow-ups.
omar: sounds reasonable. add lab access windows: partners will need 4-hour exclusive slots for hardware. I'll propose two 4-hour windows Tue/Wed.
kevin: CI/repro: provide a reproducible container and a minimal docker-compose for the test harness. also provide a small data fixture (seeded tokens) rather than real data.
julia: good call. license: kernel components we ship for the board will be under EAP terms. include a short checklist in the repo: license.txt, build_instructions.md, sha256 for artifacts.
legalbot: add a line: partners must destroy EAP binaries after the program unless otherwise agreed.
kevin: telemetry fields we'll collect (example): run_id, variant, seq_len, throughput_tok_s, lat_p99_ms, cpu_power_watts, gpu_temp_c, mem_peak_mb, host_tag. will include a sampling flag for full traces (off by default).
omar: sample collection: allow partners to opt-in to extended traces for debug, but must supply hashed identifiers only.
julia: action items:
- kevin: runbook v0 + container + CLI snippets (due Fri)
- omar: lab windows + access calendar (due Mon)
- tess: embargo + PR contact list + marketing checklist (due Mon)
- legalbot: telemetry appendix text + retention clause (due Mon)
- deploybot: create private repo and invite the working group

deploybot: system: created repo `redwood/nimbus-eap-runbook` and invited kevin, omar, tess, julia. URL: https://git.internal/redwood/nimbus-eap-runbook
kevin: perfect, I'll push a starter README and the first template today. will ping here when ready.
julia: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the canonical EAP coordination log. :rocket:
